title: RAW UNREVIEWED: f88r three illustrated material rows represent layers or recipe mixtures
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. GDT791 admits f88r as a material register, and IDEA648 already asks serial chain versus parallel outputs. Theophilus I.1–9, recorded in IDEA390, names compound colours and distinguishes recipe identity from earlier/later deposited paint layers. This new contrast asks whether a complete f88r reading treats two pictured material rows as retained layers of one product or as ingredients mixed into one undifferentiated product. Freeze all three row owners and complete text before selecting terms. The historical paint source is only an architectural comparator; no source-to-target identity, layer, or word is established. Raw unreviewed and untested.

design.mechanism: one product can retain ordered physical layers or erase source identity in a homogeneous mixture
design.unit: three already admitted f88r material-row owners with complete prose blocks
design.contrast: ordered retained layers versus homogeneous mixture versus independent entries
design.prediction: A layer reading must preserve earlier and later physical positions and a common product owner; mixture reading predicts a single resulting material without separately addressable layers. Row order alone is not enough.
